# Cowy

> AI accuracy for baby & kids brands. Cowy makes sure that when AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) talk about your baby or kids brand, they get the facts right. We find every wrong, outdated, or misattributed answer, fix the sources behind it, and prove the correction.

Cowy is a done-for-you service built only for baby & kids consumable DTC brands on Shopify: formula, baby food & pouches, diapers, wipes, skincare & bath, and kids vitamins. The job is keeping what AI says about your products accurate. That means your ingredients, your age ranges, your certifications, and your claims.

## What Cowy does
- Checks what AI assistants say about your products and flags every wrong, outdated, or misattributed fact.
- Traces each error to the source AI reads, then fixes the sources you control and out-publishes the ones you don't.
- Monitors AI answers over time and alerts you the moment a wrong fact appears.

## Method
Find → Trace → Fix → Prove: find the wrong answers, trace them to their sources, fix the sources, and prove the correction with a before/after.

## Offers
- Free check: a 30-second look at what AI gets wrong about you, with a score and your top gaps.
- AI Accuracy Report ($1,500 one-time): a dated snapshot of what AI says, re-verified the day it ships, with the fixes. Credits toward the first month of Done For You if you upgrade within 7 days.
- AI Watchdog ($79/mo or $790/yr): ongoing monitoring, the durable product since AI answers change. Alerts you the week AI states a wrong fact about your products.
- Done-For-You ($2,500/mo): monthly fixes that keep AI accurate about your brand, with proof.
